name: Fernandez Bay Village
brand_truth: A family-run village of cottages in the hollow of Fernandez Bay, Cat Island, where every room looks at the beach and the day ends at a bonfire on the sand.
buyer: US couples and families, groups renting the Manor House or Beach House, and private pilots flying into New Bight five minutes away.

design.signature: 'Who's coming?' party planner lighting up fitting cottages, adjoining pairs and villas; meal counter on published dining prices; sticky 'one day in the bay' scrollytelling with a sun arc drawn by scroll; Getting Here route chooser (FXE, Nassau, own plane)

current_site_findings: Two different front-desk numbers: contact page (954) 302-7422, footer (954) 518-4500
No meta descriptions; default Squarespace favicon
Homepage video fails to load; newsletter block shows a setup error
Cat Island / New Bight not in the first screen
No way to see adjoining cottages or total meals without emailing
pitch_line: Your site has beautiful photos but two different phone numbers and no mention of Cat Island on the first screen; this concept puts the island, the five-minute airport transfer and a 'who's coming' cottage planner up front.
assumptions: Front desk number shown is (954) 302-7422 from the contact page; footer lists (954) 518-4500
WhatsApp 1 (242) 808-5711 used for the enquiry form
Cottage photos matched by order on their cottages page
Caretaker's Cottage bed size not published, not shown
